records.criterion: NSWorkspace 启动无错误时记录成功并向上游返回 true。
records.consumer: HelperMain.main → HelperDelegate.checkRunning → launchAfterDelay → launchApplication → openApplication；运行结果传给 completeLaunchAttempt。
records.limitations: 源码级结果与 continuation 分支；不推断系统启动、进程状态或当前二进制 ABI。

records.criterion: NSWorkspace 启动错误时记录 localizedDescription 并向上游返回 false；错误不继续抛给重试调度器。
records.consumer: HelperMain.main → HelperDelegate.checkRunning → launchAfterDelay → launchApplication → openApplication；运行结果传给 completeLaunchAttempt。
records.limitations: 源码级结果与 continuation 分支；不推断系统启动、进程状态或当前二进制 ABI。

records.criterion: NSWorkspace completion 的 error 非空时优先 resume throwing；无 error 时 application 必须非空，否则 trap；正常 application 则 resume returning，一次完成 checked continuation。
records.consumer: HelperMain.main → HelperDelegate.checkRunning → launchAfterDelay → launchApplication → openApplication；运行结果传给 completeLaunchAttempt。
records.limitations: 源码级结果与 continuation 分支；不推断系统启动、进程状态或当前二进制 ABI。
